description: The one that's meant to land badly. Nothing violent happens on screen and nobody explains anything, which is the register the whole order is written in.
name: Somebody is being collected

lines: Two of them are putting a third person into a van, briskly and without conversation.
A door on this row is standing open and the flat behind it's empty.
Somebody is being helped into a vehicle by the elbow. They aren't resisting.

stage.text: They took someone off the row in {place} this morning. Nobody has said what for, including them.
An individual was detained in {place} in connection with an ongoing matter — the Basin considers the matter closed.
